reason: Blood travels outward through arteries before reaching the capillaries, so those routes should connect first.

reason: The open return side should connect to the veins to complete the route.
expectation: The veins will join the capillary bed as the route back toward the heart.

effect: Joining the veins completed the vessel network and showed the full route away from and back toward the heart.
reaction: The continuous arrow made the three parts fit together clearly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting capillaries to body cells was most worthwhile: the picture showed which materials move between them and why the vessels need to be close.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the vein felt repetitive after lining the artery, though it made sense from the pictures.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the picture to show a nearby muscle squeezing a vein while the valves direct blood forward.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I'd choose to continue: seeing the separate vessel parts become one route was satisfying, and I'd be curious how it connects with the heart.
